sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN Tx buffer element size configuration register (FDCAN_TXESC)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.36 "FDCAN Tx buffer element size configuration register (FDCAN_TXESC)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3711.
sections.section_content:
Configures the number of data bytes belonging to a Tx buffer element. Data field sizes >8
bytes are intended for CAN FD operation only.
Address offset: 0x00C8
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:3 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 2:0 TBDS[2:0]: Tx buffer data field size:
000: 8-byte data field
001: 12-byte data field
010: 16-byte data field
011: 20-byte data field
100: 24-byte data field
101: 32-byte data field
110: 48-byte data field
111: 64-byte data field

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
